line: 呠. imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu looks, and the look can steal or it can bless. Envy is love that demands the good thing shrink. Admiration lets it shine. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Name the exact good you wanted for yourself, out loud, and leave it with the person who has it.

z: 呡 imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line: 呡. imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele counts what could be lost. That count is love doing arithmetic. Courage is not a louder voice. It is this part staying in the room. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Stay beside the frightened person until the breath slows. Do not explain the dark away first.

z: 呣 imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line: 呣. imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla closes when it thinks tomorrow is empty. Greed is that closing. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Give the first portion, not the remainder. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 呤 imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line: 呤. imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is near the place speech begins. The tongue can cut a family in one extra sentence. Healing speech tells the truth and refuses the insult. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 呥 imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line: 呥. imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is easy to overlook because it works. Contempt is the shortcut that will not look. Appreciation is looking that stays. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Thank the person for this labor, not for being easy to live with.

z: 呧 imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line: 呧. imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele can be in the room while the person has left. That is the punishing silence. Presence is the same quiet, warmed by staying. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Put the glowing thing down. Let this part of you be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 呩 imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line: 呩. imigudu yenyongo, ithumbu lokuqala, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla remembers a break. Betrayal proves the bond was real. Forgiveness does not pretend the bowl never cracked. It eats from the bowl with the crack still gold. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it.
